title: Prove the normal reset preserves both original Commons IO marks
description: Check the real string-backed CharBuffer and heap ByteBuffer on two actual process defaults with explicit and implicit encoder selection. Use the exact mark and reset bytecode, resolved NIO bridges and a conservative arbitrary re-encoding state to check the induction base and normal-reset step for any number of intervening public reads and successful resets. Require the original parent to refute the same preservation step and measure 32 consecutive concrete cycles on every process profile.
